title: The infinite Walmart
content: Most of my dreams start in one place but end in the same mega Walmart supercenter. It’s always the same one. And most of the time I’m in like a die hard scenario where bad guys takeover the store. I’m always the John McClain in the dream and sometimes others are free and running around too. Or I’m just shopping there. I think it’s cause I used to work at a Walmart so it’s somehow invaded my dreamscape
